description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'DistributedGrainDirectory' in the Orleans runtime, which manages grain directory operations such as lookup, registration, unregistration, and recovery. It handles cluster membership changes, view updates, and partition management, following virtual synchrony and Paxos-like protocols for consistency during view changes and node failures.

classes.name: DistributedGrainDirectory
classes.description: Manages the grain directory in Orleans, handling registration, lookup, recovery, and cluster membership updates, with support for view changes and partition management.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Performs a lookup for a grain address by grain ID.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address in the directory.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a grain address from the directory.

methods.name: RecoverRegisteredActivations
methods.description: Recovers registered activations within a specified range during view changes or node failures.

methods.name: GetRegisteredActivations
methods.description: Retrieves registered activations within a specified range, optionally validating.

methods.name: GetPrimaryForGrain
methods.description: Returns the primary silo address responsible for a given grain ID.

methods.name: GetLocalRecord
methods.description: Gets the local record for a grain ID if owned by the local silo.
